headline: SSH is opened to the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0). This enables brute force and exploit attempts against a production instance, even if INFRA-2291 later moves it behind Session Manager.

findings.evidence_ref: New ingress rule with from_port=22, to_port=22, protocol=tcp, cidr_blocks=["0.0.0.0/0"]
findings.explanation: SSH is exposed to the entire internet, enabling brute force attacks and attempts to exploit SSH vulnerabilities. Even as a temporary measure, this is internet-facing attack surface that should be constrained to known on-call IP ranges or a bastion host.
